requirements.title: AI assistant UX and rendering safety

taskTemplates.frontend: small-context packet with AI feature files and npm/browser validation

compatibility.composition: strictly additive edits move the composition entries for this stage per the stage-4 precedent: src/features/index.ts appends aiAssistantModule to featureModules (the only file where cross-feature imports are legal) and src/main.ts appends the /assistant route + Routes.Assistant import; kernel (src/core), utils, shared components, the auth/chats/profile features and src/pages stay untouched
compatibility.botContract: stage 9 accepted REST contract consumed read-only: POST /chats/{id}/messages (MessageCreate) then POST /chats/{id}/bot/runs with the created message_id; BotRunResponse {status, attempt, error_kind, response_message_id, attachment_file_id}; the bot answer text is fetched from the accepted GET /chats/{id}/messages history by response_message_id
compatibility.ragContract: stage 8 accepted scoped search consumed read-only: POST /chats/{id}/documents/search returns chat-scoped DocumentChunkResponse rows (file_id, ordinal, content, score) that feed the document cards
compatibility.adapters: feature-owned api directory mirrors the stage-7 idiom: api/index.ts selects by env.mode, api/own.ts performs real HTTP through HTTPTransport against the owned backend, api/practicum.ts throws an explicit unsupported error (AI endpoints exist only in own mode) - no cross-feature imports anywhere in the feature
compatibility.rendering: no bot-, chat- or backend-supplied value is ever rendered through triple-stache: triple-stache is reserved for registered component-helper calls (the repository's only child-embedding mechanism, whose helpers emit the wrapping raw HTML), while every data interpolation inside feature templates uses double-stache text escaping; document links are built exclusively by the feature safety seam from an integer file_id joined onto the configured apiUrl through utils joinUrl (files/{id}/download), so javascript:, data: and foreign origins are structurally rejected and tested as such
compatibility.store: a typed aiAssistant slice on the global store (stage-4 idiom; Store.ts is write-forbidden with closed AppState, so slice reads/writes use the same cast idiom as chatsSlice and withStore mapStateToProps declares only its own key) with withStore-connected page and components; states idle/searching/typing/success/empty/error
compatibility.tests: colocated src/features/ai-assistant/*.test.ts under the existing mocha+chai+sinon+jsdom stack: state machine with a fake port, URL sanitizer rejection matrix, text-escaping renders and page state transitions; npm run verify is the deterministic gate
compatibility.dependencies: zero new npm dependencies - package.json and package-lock.json are write-forbidden
compatibility.styles: styles/ai-assistant.scss is imported from feature-local TS (pages/assistant.ts import '../styles/ai-assistant.scss'), which typechecks through the existing src/vite-env.d.ts vite/client '*.scss' module declaration; the centralized src/scss entry and components/_all.scss stay untouched
